content.name: Shield

time.condition: which you take when you are hit by an attack or targeted by the {@spell magic missile} spell

entries: An invisible barrier of magical force appears and protects you. Until the start of your next turn, you have a +5 bonus to AC, including against the triggering attack, and you take no damage from {@spell magic missile}.

content.name: Shield

time.condition: which you take when you are hit by an attack roll or targeted by the Magic Missile spell

entries: An imperceptible barrier of magical force protects you. Until the start of your next turn, you have a +5 bonus to AC, including against the triggering attack, and you take no damage from {@spell Magic Missile|SRD52}.
